svg.title: contextzip in three steps
svg.desc: Step 1, pack: running cz scans 37,949 files and packs the 62 that matter into a 114 KB ZIP. Step 2, paste: the ZIP is attached in an AI chat with a request, and the AI returns a ZIP of changed files. Step 3, apply: running cz apply-zip merges the six returned files back into the project, keeping your own edits.
